title: Currently overdue
statementMd:
As of 2024-07-01, list loans that are still out and past their due date. Show loan id and days overdue.

Expected columns: `id`, `days_overdue`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT id, CAST(julianday('2024-07-01') - julianday(due_date) AS INTEGER) AS days_overdue FROM loans WHERE return_date IS NULL AND due_date < '2024-07-01';
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
